focus.name: scene-resource-query-vram-debug
focus.purpose: Bound the complete scene-script-pending VDP query stream and preserve its non-returning diagnostic dump path.

target.name: SceneResource_DebugQueryVramStream
target.contract: Gate on SCENE_SCRIPT_PENDING == 2, write TERRAIN_QUERY_FLAGS to VDP addresses derived from SCENE_SCRIPT_DATA while advancing by two, then enter the terminal VDP readback loop when the cursor reaches 0x0E10.

branches.stream: Writes the current TERRAIN_QUERY_FLAGS byte as a VDP word and advances SCENE_SCRIPT_DATA by two until the cursor reaches 0x0E10.
branches.exhausted: Reads 1800 VDP words from the zero-based VDP address into the low byte of DEBUG_VDP_READBACK_BUFFER, then loops at 0x001B315A.

limitations: The whole-ROM reference export reports no direct static caller for this entry.
The routine's terminal infinite loop and fixed VDP readback are recorded as exact behavior; the intended diagnostic consumer is not identified.
